## Highlights

- Improved native-behavior alignment for collisions, joints, tracks, continuous collision detection and object lifetimes.
- Refined desktop rendering, fonts, animation, camera behavior and framebuffer capture.
- Added persistent local account, cloud-save, achievement, leaderboard and social substitutes, with explicitly configured compatible-service endpoints.
- Improved native-layout sign-in, registration, password reset, session renewal and asynchronous callback ownership.
- Preserved the original wallet flow with six zero-price local coin products; no real-money purchases are performed.
- Expanded input-driven game-flow regression coverage, including early-level progression, rewards, save restoration and failure/retry transitions.
- Fixed screenshot-mode exit persistence that could leave rewards pending and allow duplicate settlement.
- Updated dependencies and release tooling, including required runtime-font validation and macOS metadata checks.

## Downloads

This prerelease provides macOS ARM64, Windows x86_64/ARM64 and Linux x86_64/ARM64 packages. Each archive includes the runtime data, executables, README, license and build information. Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS`.

Linux packages require the system window/audio libraries and a supported graphics driver. See the packaged README for startup options and service configuration.

## Known limitations

This is an unfinished desktop rehost, not a complete native-equivalence claim. There is no Wasm/browser build in this release. Retired Rovio services and real platform payments are not restored; local services are substitutes, and compatible online services require an independently operated endpoint. Telepods testing uses code injection rather than camera scanning. Full natural completion of every level and exact rendering/physics parity on every platform remain unverified.

Repository-authored code is AGPL-3.0-or-later. Original game resources retain their respective rights and are not relicensed by the project's source-code license.
